name: PriceLasso: Price Tracker & Price History
description:
The best price tracker for Amazon, Walmart, Costco, Nike, Lululemon and many more. Check price history charts to make sure you are getting a good deal from stores like Chewy, Macy's, and Vuori.

Start price tracking on over 250+ stores by clicking the green PriceLasso button on any product page. Rope in the best deals automatically with price drop alerts and view price history to know it's a good deal. 

With 300,000+ alerts created, we've already helped shoppers rope in over $10M in savings, averaging $15 saved per alert!

With the PriceLasso price tracker, you can:
✅ Automatically create price alerts
✅ Track any product on Amazon, Walmart, and more
✅ Easily import Amazon wishlists, items in your shopping cart, and saved for later products
✅ Get price tracking email alerts 24/7 when the price drops
✅ See price history charts on sites like Wayfair, Macys, and Office Depot


Looking to make a big purchase like a new TV from Best Buy, drill from Home Depot, or new pair of Nike running shoes from Sam's Club? You can easily track the prices from leading online stores like Amazon, Walmart, and eBay and buy when the price drops.

Online stores like Amazon have hundreds of millions of price changes per day. How do you make sure you're getting the best price?
With the PriceLasso price tracker, you'll always get the best price with intelligent price alerts. Easily import your Amazon wishlist, shopping cart, and saved for later items for price tracking. 

With our price tracking extension, you can automatically create price alerts, track any product on the most popular online stores, and get alerts 24/7 when the price drops.
